title: Categorical naturality pasting for trace transport
statement: Let C,D,E,W,Z be categories. Let P:C→D, Q:E→C, F:E→D, H:C→E, R:Z→D, R₀:W→C, U:W→Z, V:C→W, W₀:D→Z and T,T₀:D→E be functors, with natural isomorphisms b:U⋙R≅R₀⋙P, d:H⋙Q≅V⋙R₀, s:P⋙W₀≅V⋙U, e:T⋙F≅W₀⋙R, c:F≅Q⋙P and z:T≅T₀. Choose B in C, B' in D, L in W, K in Z, isomorphisms a:U(L)≅K, v:V(B)≅L, l:P(B)≅B', k:W₀(B')≅K, and an arrow g:T₀(P(B))→H(B). Choose J,J' in E, J₀ in C, J₁ in D, and arrows u:J→J', uQ:Q(J)→J₀, uP:P(J₀)→J₁, uF:F(J')→J₁. Suppose (1) b.hom at V(B) followed by P(d.inv at B) equals R(s.inv at B), e.inv at P(B), F(z.hom at P(B) followed by g), c.hom at H(B); (2) a.inv followed by U(v.inv) and s.inv at B equals k.inv followed by W₀(l.inv); (3) c.hom at J followed by P(uQ) and uP equals F(u) followed by uF. Lists of arrows are composed in their written order. Then for every τ:H(B)→J, middleComposite R b a from def-sf-p1-integral-transport-data, followed by P(R₀(v.inv) followed by d.inv at B), P(Q(τ) followed by uQ), and uP equals R(k.inv), followed by e.inv at B', F(z.hom at B' followed by T₀(l.inv), g, τ, u), and uF. No invertibility of g, τ or the unit arrows is assumed. Here the five-factor expression inside F is packaged by the actual generic construction traceComposite from def-sf-p1-integral-transport-data.

source.place: The categorical naturality calculation carrying the arbitrary trace through the three comparison squares in the second triangle.

proof.text: Use naturality of b to move v.inv across the middle comparison. Apply the geometric equation (1), combine the three consecutive R-images and use the coefficient equation (2). Naturality of e.inv moves l.inv across exchange. Naturality of c.hom moves the arbitrary trace tau across pullback composition. Equation (3) finishes the unit factors. Functoriality and associativity justify each reassociation. Finally naturality of z moves the inverse coefficient comparison to the ordinary direct-image side of forget-supports.

proof_origin.place: The categorical naturality pasting in the second triangle calculation.

lean.statement:
theorem traceTransportPasting
    {C D E W Z : Type*} [Category C] [Category D] [Category E]
    [Category W] [Category Z]
    (P : C ⥤ D) (Q : E ⥤ C) (F : E ⥤ D) (H : C ⥤ E)
    (R : Z ⥤ D) (R₀ : W ⥤ C) (U : W ⥤ Z) (V : C ⥤ W)
    (W₀ : D ⥤ Z) (T : D ⥤ E)
    (b : U ⋙ R ≅ R₀ ⋙ P) (d : H ⋙ Q ≅ V ⋙ R₀)
    (s : P ⋙ W₀ ≅ V ⋙ U) (e : T ⋙ F ≅ W₀ ⋙ R) (c : F ≅ Q ⋙ P)
    {B : C} {B' : D} {L : W} {K : Z}
    (a : U.obj L ≅ K) (v : V.obj B ≅ L) (l : P.obj B ≅ B')
    (k : W₀.obj B' ≅ K) (T₀ : D ⥤ E) (z : T ≅ T₀)
    (g : T₀.obj (P.obj B) ⟶ H.obj B)
    {J J' : E} {J₀ : C} {J₁ : D}
    (u : J ⟶ J') (uQ : Q.obj J ⟶ J₀) (uP : P.obj J₀ ⟶ J₁)
    (uF : F.obj J' ⟶ J₁) (τ : H.obj B ⟶ J)
    (hb : b.hom.app (V.obj B) ≫ P.map (d.inv.app B) =
      R.map (s.inv.app B) ≫ e.inv.app (P.obj B) ≫
        F.map (z.hom.app (P.obj B) ≫ g) ≫ c.hom.app (H.obj B))
    (ha : a.inv ≫ U.map v.inv ≫ s.inv.app B = k.inv ≫ W₀.map l.inv)
    (hu : c.hom.app J ≫ P.map uQ ≫ uP = F.map u ≫ uF) :
    middleComposite R b a ≫ P.map (R₀.map v.inv ≫ d.inv.app B) ≫
        P.map (Q.map τ ≫ uQ) ≫ uP =
      R.map k.inv ≫ e.inv.app B' ≫ F.map (traceComposite T T₀ z l g τ u) ≫ uF
